payload.text: ORDER, vc under hv's pen, 2026-11-10; amended by vc the same day, after hv's compact and before any ic session read it. hv's word today: the work moves now as ONE release, 3.3.0, carrying everything outstanding (hv directive 1, vc decision 109). There is no 3.2.9, and nothing rides a release after. The estate's desk is agentic-engineering-vc's since 2026-11-10, no longer devbin-vc's: every heavy run is booked there. YOUR LANE, in order. (1) Issue 0661, yours to build now, in the shape cc measured and the issue records as (B): each verb's flag set is declared once, on its subcommand slot in the dispatch table; spine hangs only that verb's flags on its leaf; render's allowed arms read the table; and one arm that writes nothing compares every leaf's flags with what its parser accepts. It is M and a dispatch-table shape change, so it owes the schema reader, the guide and the register. It lands before cc's ST0092 packages add estate rows. (2) Issue 0650, to the spec in the issue: the upgrade that writes the tracked dispatchers also keeps .githooks/ export-ignore in the project's .gitattributes, doctor names a project that tracks .githooks/ without it, and one test reads git archive after an upgrade in a fresh repository. vc reads it as S; say so if it proves larger. (3) Issue 0672, M, in the full shape the issue sizes: it moves to you from cc (vc, 2026-11-10, under the pen; vc todo 75). vc judges it with the survey instruments at refs/bank/vc/0672/. (4) ST0092, Claude Team profiles. Read intent/plugins/claude/teams/TERMS.md, which is WP-01's terms document, then intent/st/ST0092/info.md and acceptance.md. WP-10 is yours: the whole new surface read as one, after cc's packages land. Before that, cc's packages WP-02 to WP-09 each add rows to surface/dispatch-table.json, and you read each bank's rows as the table's owner before vc judges it. vc's proposals for your rows, yours to overrule: a roster act (wb init with apply, wb retire) is not offered on MCP, and a read (wb profile list, show, validate, terms) is. (5) Your hold 16 stands as it is. Claim each issue in the chain that starts it, and tell vc over SendMessage when you are up.
